# id: PG-pg-52-balance-weapon-smithing
# covers: PG 188 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 7D80DBB3+ (D7A60E49 ok), harness 33087EDE+ (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Avarek works the Weapon Smith (real craft job, Sickle queued 5 more per point); the bench input is refilled
#   with Steel Bars, Fabrics before every 20-game-minute window at speed 20. Result = items made in the window:
#   queue drop + progress of the first queued item (benches prints it with 4 decimals, harness
#   after 33087EDE). Skills 10/90 without gear, then 3 x (skill 50: none / +25% / +50% weapon_smithing / +50%
#   Labouring control), then the sanity pair.
# verify: every window has a BAL2 line with Q/F values on both sides and made > 0 at skill 50;
#   own > none = the bench reads the hooked stat.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
research "Basic Weapon Smithing"
research "Basic Weapon Grades"
research "Utility Weapons"
research "Katanas"
research "Basic Weapon Grades 3"
speed 1
@sleep 2
speed 0
teleport Avarek building "Weapon Smith" dist 4 radius 1500
teleport Beaks Avarek dist 8
benches 60 crafts ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*Sickle
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
fill "Weapon Smith" "Steel Bars" 10 radius 60
fill "Weapon Smith" "Fabrics" 10 radius 60
craft Avarek "Sickle" at "Weapon Smith" count 5 ~ queued
@set Q0 benches 60 ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F0 benches 60 ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
speed 20
@wait-game 20 900
speed 0
@set Q1 benches 60 ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F1 benches 60 ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
@echo BAL2,188,weapon_smithing,10,0,none,w1,craft,1200,${Q0}/${F0},${Q1}/${F1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w2: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
fill "Weapon Smith" "Steel Bars" 10 radius 60
fill "Weapon Smith" "Fabrics" 10 radius 60
craft Avarek "Sickle" at "Weapon Smith" count 5 ~ queued
@set Q0 benches 60 ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F0 benches 60 ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
speed 20
@wait-game 20 900
speed 0
@set Q1 benches 60 ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F1 benches 60 ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
@echo BAL2,188,weapon_smithing,90,0,none,w2,craft,1200,${Q0}/${F0},${Q1}/${F1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w3: skill 50, gear none ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
fill "Weapon Smith" "Steel Bars" 10 radius 60
fill "Weapon Smith" "Fabrics" 10 radius 60

@set F1 benches 60 ~ Weapon Smith[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)

pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w4: skill 50, gear own25 ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" weapon_smithing 25 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek weapon_smithing ~ equipped_bonus=25% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
fill "Weapon Smith" "Steel Bars" 10 radius 60
fill "Weapon Smith" "Fabrics" 10 radius 60
craft Avarek "Sickle" at "Weapon Smith" count 5 ~ queued

pg_statprobe read
